name: resource-fields
description: Every deposit type renders its field model; Crude Oil offers no hand harvest; a Mine fills from the nearest mineral deposit and ignores the rest; an Oil Well pumps Crude Oil from the seep beside it. Extraction rules themselves are unit tested.

steps.comment: One field of each deposit along map row z 4, x 3 to 8.
Map cell (8, 4) spans z 16..20; the player stands 1 unit past its edge, beside the seep only.
Iron Ore at (5, 8) is 1 unit from the Mine's center (25, 34), Coal at (7, 8) is 3.
The Oil Well's center (37, 18) is 1 unit from the seep at (8, 4).
250 frames is about 8.3 s: one Iron Ore at 8 s a unit and two Crude Oil at 4 s.
Collectors fill their own buffers: the Mine (buildings[1]) and the Oil Well (buildings[2]).
